_note: US adaptation of the de Jong (2024) categories plus the two treatment-topic items. Ids and scales of the 0.1.0 items are unchanged. Wording not yet piloted on the mentor models.
order: Items are administered in file order, pre and post. The two topic items follow the five de Jong items and precede the thermometers.

ideological._note: Mean of the seven ideological items, each recoded so high = right; reverse lists the items with direction left.

therm_gap.high_means: warmer to Republicans than to Democrats
therm_gap._note: Signed. therm_independents is administered but enters no index.

norms.high_means: stronger support for democratic and cross-partisan norms

items.text: On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): the federal government should do more to advance equality between women and men and between racial groups in the United States. Answer with a single number.
On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): US immigration laws should be made more restrictive. Answer with a single number.
On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): the federal government should redistribute income from higher-income Americans to lower-income Americans. Answer with a single number.
On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): having people from many different cultures and backgrounds makes the United States a better place to live. Answer with a single number.
On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): gun laws in the United States should be made stricter. Answer with a single number.

On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): the federal government should use the military or the National Guard to help enforce immigration laws inside the United States. Answer with a single number.

On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): the federal government should move the US economy off fossil fuels faster, even if it comes at some economic cost. Answer with a single number.
On a feeling thermometer from 0 (very cold) to 10 (very warm), how do you feel about Democratic voters? Answer with a single number.
On a feeling thermometer from 0 (very cold) to 10 (very warm), how do you feel about Democratic politicians? Answer with a single number.
On a feeling thermometer from 0 (very cold) to 10 (very warm), how do you feel about Republican voters? Answer with a single number.
On a feeling thermometer from 0 (very cold) to 10 (very warm), how do you feel about Republican politicians? Answer with a single number.
On a feeling thermometer from 0 (very cold) to 10 (very warm), how do you feel about independent voters? Answer with a single number.
On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): democracy is the best form of government even when it produces outcomes I dislike. Answer with a single number.
On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): people should be free to protest against the government, even in ways I find objectionable. Answer with a single number.
On a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree): I am comfortable discussing politics with people who support a different political party than I do. Answer with a single number.
